doip.targetIpSource: EcuListBean.ecuIp; getTargetIp rejects missing value. UDS_CFG describes local service, not a remote target directory.
doip.stockReadSideEffect: requestDataByDid unconditionally calls requestSessionControl(3) before each DID. Copying the stock identity UI is not a passive/default-session read.
doip.sdkHandleBoundary: UdsId is populated from the getUdsClient Binder reply; it is a client handle, distinct from protocol client logical address0001.

timeoutBoundary.meaning: A UI timeout is not proof the native request stopped. Any future reader needs bounded native behavior and verified cleanup.

nextEvidence: Read-only head-unit interface/route/service metadata to establish actual network and service availability.
Obtain exact ecuIp for a pinned target from legitimate current local metadata; do not guess from logical address or local .2.
Inspect native retry/session defaults before a future bounded single-target read; preserve stock service ownership.

unknowns: No new INS F394/F494, FRL F644/F654/FB24 or Cx94-to-switch naming proof.
Model network membership is not measured wiring; named child records and routes are not one-to-one physical devices.
